summary.text: Bradley Bos is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 157 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Mitch Boggs.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Bos described himself as a school bus driver, husband, father and community advocate focused on public schools and fair wages.

paragraphs.text: Bradley Bos earned a high school diploma from Pierce City High School, and his career experience includes working as a school bus driver.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his key messages are fully funding public schools and supporting teachers, fighting for better wages and lower everyday costs, and bringing honesty and accountability to Jefferson City.

He named funding education as his top priority and listed the Teamsters, the Springfield Central Labor Council, the Missouri Young Democrats, the Missouri AFL-CIO, the Communications Workers of America and Abortion Action Missouri as endorsers.
